answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the image: it was set up and all the people were commanded to worship it, and the refusal of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego to worship it is part of its story.

clauses.english: was set up by Nebuchadnezzar in the plain of Dura
clauses.quote: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

clauses.english: was worshipped by all the people at the sound of the music
clauses.quote: all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image

clauses.english: was refused worship by Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who would not worship it
clauses.quote: we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

doubts: The summary already names the setting up in Dura, so the first clause may partly restate it.
The third clause leans on the men's refusal, which could be seen as the story of the men rather than of the image.
